gaps.sentence: I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
gaps.explanation: regret + to-infinitive (formal announcements); regret + -ing = be sorry about the past.

gaps.sentence: We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
Renovating the kitchen involved ___ a wall.
They can't help ___ at his impression of the boss.
gaps.explanation: can't help + -ing = can't stop yourself: can't help laughing.

gaps.sentence: We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.

gaps.sentence: Do you want me ___ you at the station?
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want me to meet.

gaps.sentence: She decided ___ the job offer in Berlin.
gaps.explanation: decide takes the to-infinitive: decided to accept.

gaps.sentence: You should stop ___ so much coffee late at night.
gaps.explanation: stop + -ing = end the activity: stop drinking coffee.
